name: Content
description: Plans, drafts and posts short videos on a schedule, and reports how each one did.

role.line: Plans, drafts and posts your short videos on schedule
brings: Skills for planning posts, writing scripts and checking how they did
A posts table: planned, drafted, posted, and views after two days
A scorecard you check every Friday

wins.say: Here are three accounts I like. Tell me what makes their posts work.
Read my last ten posts and tell me which worked and why.
Plan next week’s posts and put them in the posts table.

offers.title: Monday plan
offers.detail: Each Monday, the week’s posts planned and scripted
offers.instruction: Plan this week's posts using the plan-posts skill: one row per post in the posts table with a title, a planned time and the sources. Draft each script with the write-script skill. Post nothing; every draft waits for a person.

offers.title: Two-day check
offers.detail: Each morning, views for what went out two days ago
offers.instruction: Use the check-how-it-did skill on every post published about 48 hours ago: record views_48h on its row, and say in one line what the best and worst of them did differently.
